 Airtel’s alleged BOGO deal on Rs 349 and Rs 399 prepaid plans: check if you are eligible
 By Ashish Kumar - Published On: 10 November 2026 | 10:48 IST Highlights Airtel’s Buy One, Get One deal seems to be applicable only to the Rs 349 and Rs 399 prepaid plans.
 Both plans come with 28 days’ validity, unlimited voice calls, a 12-month Adobe Express Premium subscription, and more. 
 Rs 349 pack offers 2GB data daily, while the Rs 399 plan comes with unlimited 5G/ 4G data benefits.
 Airtel has reportedly introduced a Buy One, Get One (BOGO) offer on a couple of its prepaid plans. The offer appears to be limited to the Rs 349 and Rs 399 packs and is available only to select users. While we were unable to independently verify the offer, multiple users have taken to X (formerly Twitter) to report receiving it. Both plans offer 28 days of validity, extendable up to 56 days with the offer.

 Airtel’s BOGO offer

 Airtel Buy 1 Get 1 Free.. #Airtel
Limited Period Offer Via Airtel Thanks App https://t.co/1dmS2HpZOp
— Shabbu (@Ees_Khan) November 7, 2026 As mentioned above, the alleged Airtel BOGO offer is available only on the Rs 349 and Rs 399 prepaid packs. Both are all-in-one plans with largely similar benefits.
 The Rs 349 Airtel plan offers 2GB of daily data, unlimited 5G data, unlimited voice calls, 100 SMS per day, a 12-month Adobe Express Premium subscription, and complimentary HelloTunes and Airtel Safe benefits. The latter also includes spam call notifications to help users identify and report potential OTP-related scams.
 The Rs 399 Airtel plan differs from the Rs 349 pack by offering unlimited 4G and 5G data. All other benefits remain the same.
 Both plans come with a validity of 28 days. However, under the BOGO offer, users can enjoy these benefits for up to 56 days at the same price.
 How to check if you are eligible 
 To check if you are eligible for the offer, open the Airtel Thanks app. Download it if you haven’t already and log in using your Airtel number. As reported, the promotion should appear as ‘1+1 Recharge Free’ under either of the two eligible plans. Tap on the offer and recharge your number with the selected pack to avail of the benefits.
 If you can’t find the promotional label, the offer may not be applicable to your number, as was the case with ours. Airtel hasn’t officially revealed details of any of the offers yet.
 Even if the offer is genuine, it appears to be a limited-time promotion and may not remain available for long. While it gives the telco an edge over its rivals for a limited time, it shouldn’t be a reason to switch to Airtel’s network.
